user.title: Tantos Jolly
user.description: Connect one call panel or camera channel from your Tantos Jolly hub. Add the integration again for each additional channel.

error.cannot_connect: Could not log in. Check the IP address, username and password -- and make sure the official vhOme app isn't currently connected to the panel (it holds the only session slot).

abort.already_configured: This channel on this hub is already configured.
